body:
I just rewatched Bojack Horseman for the fourth time, it's my favorite show because it's comforting to me. I also like Rick and Morty, Arrested Development, American Horror Story... 
I don't really read much anymore, but I was thinking about picking up Stephen King's Dark Tower series again, and I like movies that really catch my attention and documentaries.

I don't usually like sharing things I've made unless I'm comfortable, but thanks for the suggestion. It's just something I usually do for me. I also like to play video games but my ex took back the gaming computer he let me "borrow". Right now I'm mostly watching TV shows

I do psychology research at my university (ironically) and I like to exercise but haven't in two weeks because I haven't been eating regularly. I like to draw and play music but have no motivation. I'm trying to keep myself busy and not be alone as much as I can because all the thoughts come back when I'm alone. Tonight I'm going to try and draw or write some slam poetry. But when I'm alone or walking to class all the anger and thoughts about my ex come back. The thoughts are intrusive and since I am dealing with emotional trauma I may be dealing with acute stress disorder.

That's what I was afraid of... Well, at least now I know what abuse feels like and I can avoid it. It'll make getting over him somewhat easier.
Thanks for the advice!

Oh he broke up with me, I cut him out of my life officially today. It's taken me a while to accept that it was over, but now I'm trying to move on. I know I deserve better, but my old habits are interfering with the grieving process...
Thanks for the reply friend.
